title: The UK Payments Forward Plan in 2026: Stablecoins, Open Banking, Tokenised Deposits, and Agentic Payments
item_description: The 2026 UK payments policy blueprint — stablecoins, tokenised deposits, Open Banking, AI-agent payments, PSR/FCA consolidation, and the Wholesale Digital Markets Champion role.
excerpt: The UK Payments Forward Plan and April 2026 policy package set out a single framework for traditional payments, stablecoins, tokenised deposits, open banking, and agentic payments. The strategic question for banks is design discipline: which data, rails, controls, liabilities, and client workflows belong together — and how to evidence the orchestration to regulators.
subtitle: The UK is moving payments regulation toward one coherent framework across bank payments, e-money, stablecoins, tokenised deposits, open banking, and AI agents.
